Large overfanout of the '<subject> policy officer' family (~20+: housing, regional, competition, fiscal, cultural, environmental, agricultural, labour, education, recreation, immigration, social-services, public-health, etc.) — these are public-policy/government roles that arguably belong in a Public Policy domain, not Compliance/Regulation. Domain is labelled 'Higher Education' but is polluted with non-HE levels: primary/secondary/preschool/kindergarten teachers (primary school teacher, early years teacher, Montessori/Steiner/Freinet, secondary school head teacher, special-ed primary/secondary) and the whole vocational-teacher family belong in schools/D040 Vocational, not HE.
